description.zh-CN: Git 操作：状态 / 差异 / 日志 / 提交（可撤销）/ 推送
description.en-US: Git ops: status / diff / log / commit (undoable) / push

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Show git working-tree status: current branch, ahead/behind vs upstream, and changed entries (x = index status, y = worktree status; '??' = untracked, 'A' = staged add, 'M' = modified, 'D' = deleted). Args: repo (required).

repo.description: absolute path to the repository (must be inside the allowed workspace roots)

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Show the unified diff of unstaged changes (default) or staged changes. Args: repo (required), staged (bool, default false), path (optional, restrict the diff to one file). Output is capped at 256KiB and flags `truncated`.

repo.description: absolute path to the repository (must be inside the allowed workspace roots)

staged.description: diff the index instead of the worktree (default false)

path.description: optional path relative to the repo root

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: List recent commits, newest first. Args: repo (required), limit (default 20, max 100), path (optional, only commits touching that path). Returns {commits: [{hash, short, author, date, subject}]}; empty list for a repo without commits.

repo.description: absolute path to the repository (must be inside the allowed workspace roots)

path.description: optional path relative to the repo root

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Stage files and create a commit. Args: repo (required), message (required), add (array of paths relative to the repo root) OR add_all (bool, stage everything including deletions) — exactly one of the two. Returns {commit, short}. Undoable via git_undo_commit (soft reset keeps the changes staged) as long as HEAD is still the created commit.

repo.description: absolute path to the repository (must be inside the allowed workspace roots)

add.description: paths to stage, relative to the repo root (new files allowed)

add_all.description: stage all changes including deletions (default false)

tools.name: git_push
tools.description: Push a branch to a remote. Args: repo (required), remote (default 'origin'), branch (required). Irreversible — publishing to the remote requires user approval.

repo.description: absolute path to the repository (must be inside the allowed workspace roots)

tools.name: git_undo_commit
tools.description: Undo a previous git_commit by soft-resetting one commit (the changes stay staged). Usually invoked by the compensation layer, not by the model. Args mirror the compensation payload {call_id, args, output}; only output.{repo, commit} is used. Refuses when HEAD has moved past the recorded commit (manual intervention required). Irreversible — it rewrites repository state, so the call requires user approval.

call_id.description: id of the original git_commit call
